chapter: Garland on the New Orleans style
title: Tempo of old bands versus fast modern playing and bebop
summary: Garland criticizes fast tempos on tunes like the Saints and bebop for lacking melody.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: I was going to ask about the tempo, that is, some of the bands today I notice play things so fast, like the Saints go marching in and all. Would you say it's characteristic of New Orleans not to play things too fast, or what did you

say? Because we never know, we don't play nothing, we didn't play nothing like that fast. Now here, lately they got playing some playing pieces, I like when the Saints come marching in, they played so fast, you understand? Nobody couldn't dance, but they just played. Yeah, you couldn't do nothing. But they sat there and listened at them. No, we didn't play nothing like that. In fact it was a gallop, a gallop, you know. This whole style. No, we always played things you could march or dance part. We used to play, we'd start off. Da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da-da They're there where we shout, you know. We didn't play like these guys played. They're cleaning that fast.
Yeah, some of them today play everything so fast.

Everything is fast. I was like those bebop players. They play things, you don't know what they're playing because you don't know the melody. You can't hear no melody. There ain't no melody. They're just running a scale. Turn the saxophone and take it and he runs with 24 bars. Nothing but a scale. Then the next man he take it. What you playing? I don't know. He just played. They played South Ramport Street Parade one day. One night I played with them and never knew what I was playing until way after the thing was over. I asked him what was we playing? He said South Ramport Street Parade. Oh yeah, I couldn't take the name of it. Never knew what I was playing.
